text: OVERDOSAGE There is no antidote for overdosage of cytarabine. Doses of 4.5 g/m 2 by intravenous infusion over 1 hour every 12 hours for 12 doses have caused an unacceptable increase in irreversible CNS toxicity and death. Single doses as high as 3 g/m 2 have been administered by rapid intravenous infusion without apparent toxicity.
